step.label: Assess Engineering Change Impact on Workforce
step.description: Evaluate how proposed engineering changes affect production capability, workforce skills, and resource requirements across the organization.
step.useCase: Manufacturing planning team needs to understand skill gaps before implementing an engineering change order.

step.label: Validate Equipment Modifications and Service Requirements
step.description: Confirm that equipment changes align with existing infrastructure and identify required maintenance or integration work.
step.useCase: Plant operations must ensure equipment modifications are technically feasible before proceeding with the change.

step.label: Coordinate Workforce Performance and Capability Development
step.description: Initiate performance review cycles and capability assessments for affected employees to close identified skill gaps.
step.useCase: HR department needs to align employee development plans with the new skill requirements identified in the change impact assessment.

step.label: Analyze Material and Supply Chain Impact
step.description: Assess material specifications, inventory levels, and vendor capabilities required to support the transition.
step.useCase: Supply chain team must confirm vendor availability and material readiness before production transition.

step.label: Qualif Sales Opportunities for Transition Announcement
step.description: Evaluate and prioritize sales opportunities that align with the new product capabilities and transition timeline.
step.useCase: Sales leadership needs to identify which customer accounts should receive early notification about new production capabilities.

step.label: Validate Production Impact Analysis
step.description: Cross-reference engineering change impacts with detailed production data to confirm transition feasibility.
step.useCase: Production engineering requires detailed analytics to finalize the transition plan and timeline.

step.label: Execute Campaign and Customer Order Coordination
step.description: Launch coordinated customer communication campaigns and manage order intake for the transitioned product line.
step.useCase: Marketing and sales operations teams need to synchronize customer announcements with order management systems during transition.

step.label: Monitor Transition Incident Metrics and Engagement
step.description: Track operational incidents, safety issues, and customer engagement metrics during the production transition period.
step.useCase: Operations and customer experience teams must identify and resolve issues rapidly as the transition progresses.
